reviews.snippet: If you are planning a trip to Nandi Hills, Koteshwaram is the perfect place to stop! Located right on the highway outside Bangalore, it is ideal for a breakfast,lunch or dinner stop while heading back to the city. The restaurant is massive with a serene temple-like theme and beautiful seating options. The food quality is excellent, and they have an extensive parking space that easily handles the highway rush. A must-visit spot for families!
